natural_input.description: System overview. Only these resources: on-chip Sensor Port, ISP, Encoder, SRAM, DMA; off-chip Host. Sensor Port sends pixels to ISP; ISP writes frames to SRAM; Encoder reads SRAM; Encoder sends bitstream to DMA; DMA sends bitstream to Host. Do not add resources or connections.
